Soon we'll all be speaking^\255\003^well, English, I guess.
column2: 很快我們就會全都講^\255\003^呃，英語吧，我猜。

column1: Maybe you should switch to decaf.
column2: 也許你該改喝低咖啡因的。

column1: No!  Then I'd fall asleep, and^
column2: 不行！那樣我會睡著，然後^

column1: We're living mostly on the income from renting out our mansion.
column2: 我們主要靠出租大樓的收入過活。

column1: That and Edna's tips from her exotic dancing.
column2: 那個，再加上愛德娜跳豔舞的小費。

column1: I got the contract for you to sign, Doctor!
column2: 我把合約拿來給你簽了，博士！

column1: Sorry, I don't like to sign things I haven't read.
column2: 抱歉，我不喜歡簽沒讀過的東西。

column1: Will you PLEASE sign this contract?
column2: 拜託你簽一下這份合約好嗎？

column1: I don't sign things I haven't read.
But the whole human race is at risk!
Sign it or^ I'll^ get real mad.
column2: 簽了，不然^我^會非常生氣。

column1: Oh, forget it.  I'll get rid of Purple Tentacle myself!
column2: 喔，算了。我自己去解決紫色觸手！

column1: And do what?\255\003Not be my friend anymore?
column2: 然後呢？\255\003不跟我做朋友了嗎？

column1: I'm getting Purple Tentacle declared insane and arrested.
column2: 我要讓紫色觸手被判定精神失常然後逮捕。

column1: I'm starting up a petition to ban all tentacles.
column2: 我要發起連署禁止所有觸手。

column1: I offered Purple Tentacle a bribe and he took it.
column2: 我賄賂紫色觸手，他收了。

column1: I guess I can't.  Hey, did you join a record club lately?
column2: 我看我做不到。欸，你最近有加入唱片俱樂部嗎？

column1: But I need a note signed by a doctor^
column2: 但我需要一張醫生簽名的證明^

column1: Where'd you get that kind of money?
I used one of your checks.
Brilliant!  I'll just stop payment on it tomorrow!
Exactly!  All I need now is your signature^
column2: 沒錯！我現在只需要你的簽名^

column1: Good God, no!\255\003Those things are horrible, money-leeching death traps!
column2: 老天，不要！\255\003那種東西是恐怖的吸錢死亡陷阱！

column1: Well, there's a deliveryman upstairs with a carton of easy-listening eight-tracks for you^\255\003^he says you have to pay for them^
column2: 樓上有個送貨員帶了一箱輕音樂八軌帶要給你^\255\003^他說你得付錢^

column1: ^unless you sign this refusal form immediately^
I'm busy trying to think of a way to save humanity!
column2: 我正忙著想辦法拯救人類！

column1: Of course!  That's why I'm busy trying to think of a way to save it!
column2: 當然！所以我才忙著想辦法拯救它！

column1: Thanks!  That was a close one.
I don't have time to read!
We wait for those buddies of yours to plug in their Johns!
column2: 我們等你那兩個朋友把他們的廁所插上電！

column1: We have to buy a diamond and plug it into the Chron-O-John!
column2: 我們得買一顆鑽石插進時光廁！

column1: According to my instruments, everything is in readiness!\255\003Your friends have activated their units, so it's time to^\255\003THROW THE SWITCH!
column2: 根據我的儀器，一切就緒！\255\003你的朋友已經啟動他們的機器，該是時候^\255\003扳下開關！

column1: I'm so glad you two made it back ok!
column2: 真高興你們兩個都平安回來了！

column1: I hate to interrupt, but there's no time to lose!\255\003Now that you're back, we've got to proceed with the original plan and send you back to yesterday to turn off the Sludge-O-Matic\015.
column2: 抱歉打斷，但一刻都不能耽誤！\255\003既然你們回來了，就得照原計畫把你們送回昨天去關掉污泥自動機\015。

column1: Now, hold on a minute, Dr. Fred.\255\003They just barely made it back to our time alive, and I think--
column2: 等一下，佛瑞德博士。\255\003他們才好不容易活著回到我們的時代，我覺得——

column1: You can't turn off the machine if I get there FIRST!
column2: 我要是先到，你們就關不掉那台機器了！

column1: This time I KNOW I can stop him!
column2: 這次我知道我攔得住他！

column1: I guess we'd better do something.
column2: 我看我們最好做點什麼。

column1: You can't all go in the same stall!
column2: 你們不能全擠進同一間！
你們沒看過 `變蠅人` 嗎？！
我們變成某種怪物了，各位。

column1: Stuck here the rest of my life^\255\003^listening to Bernard talking and watching Hoagie eat.
column2: 下半輩子就困在這^\255\003^聽伯納講話，看霍基吃東西。

column1: Mom warned me there'd be days like this.
column2: 我媽警告過我會有這種日子。
紫 觸 手 在 你 後 面！！

column1: I believe he's trying to warn you about ME.
column2: 我想他是想警告你們關於「我」的事。

column1: We're going to turn off the Sludge-O-Matic\015 and defeat your evil plans, you overgrown WORM.
column2: 我們要關掉污泥自動機\015，粉碎你的邪惡計畫，你這條發育過頭的蟲。

column1: You sorry lot are no match for ME!
column2: 你們這群可憐蟲不是我的對手！

column1: But there's THREE of us--\255\003--well, sort of!
column2: 但我們有三個——\255\003——呃，算是啦！

column1: Nevertheless, I mean to crush you.
column2: 儘管如此，我還是要把你們碾碎。

column1: You see, I've been busy.\255\003These are all versions of myself from the future.\255\003I've been bringing them back here using the Chron-O-John.\255\003Together, we will CONQUER THE WORLD!!
column2: 你看，我可沒閒著。\255\003這些全是來自未來的我。\255\003我用時光廁把他們一個個帶回來。\255\003我們將一起征服世界！！

column1: Go to the basement and guard the Sludge-O-Matic\015.
column2: 去地下室守著污泥自動機\015。

column1: No one is to touch the Sludge-O-Matic\015.
column2: 任何人都不准碰污泥自動機\015。

column1: Now, creature, I must decide what excruciating tortures to--
column2: 現在，怪物，我得決定要用什麼慘無人道的酷刑——

column1: I've been itching for a chance to test out my newly completed DIMINUATOR!
column2: 我早就手癢想試試我剛完成的縮小器了！

column1: All right, the rest of you come with me!\255\003Next stop^\255\003^THE WORLD!
column2: 好了，其餘的人跟我來！\255\003下一站^\255\003^全世界！

column1: The battery must not have had time to recharge^\255\003^but it will!
column2: 電池一定是還沒來得及充電^\255\003^但它會的！

column1: You humans amount to very LITTLE.
column2: 你們人類實在「微」不足道。

column1: Run all you like, you insignificant insect!
column2: 儘管跑吧，你們這些微不足道的蟲子！
